title: Focus Guard
description: A Chrome extension that protects your attention by blocking distracting sites and taming YouTube's doom-scroll machinery — toggles to hide Shorts, the home feed, recommendations, and the comment section.

title: PDF Chatbot
description: An AI document assistant that runs entirely offline: upload a PDF, search it semantically, and hold a multi-turn conversation against a bundled local LLM. Ships as a one-click installer for Windows and Linux.

title: Music Player
description: A minimal, ad-free mobile music player: local library playback, gapless queueing, and nothing else. Built after every free player I tried buried the play button under ads and social feeds. Beta APK below.

title: Visual Pathfinding
description: An interactive grid for watching search algorithms think. Drop start and goal nodes, draw walls, and step through A*, Dijkstra, BFS, and DFS as each expands its frontier — built to make the difference between informed and uninformed search visible.

title: Wordle
description: An unlimited-play Wordle clone — same rules, no one-puzzle-a-day limit, with shareable result grids.

title: Portfolio
description: This site. A statically-exported Next.js app with MUI theming, a persisted dark/light mode, and a build-time pipeline that generates every project card screenshot.

title: ATM
description: A containerized banking service that tracks accounts and transactions end to end — a Flask and PostgreSQL API with Alembic migrations, a React front end, and a one-command Docker Compose setup.
